Hello Abbas Abu Dzarr, I'd be happy to help you understand the Defect Liability Period (DLP) and Latent Defects (LD). The Defect Liability Period (DLP) refers to the 24-month period during which a developer is responsible for rectifying any defects, shrinkage, or faults in a building or common property that become apparent. 

Latent Defects (LD), on the other hand, refer to hidden or underlying defects that are not immediately apparent but may surface over time. These defects may not be noticeable during the initial inspection or even during the DLP, but can cause significant problems later on.
